glow.encoding: laid out like the sheet: each channel holds the glow light g as g / (1 + g); decode g = x / (1 - x). The sheet's colour already holds 1 - exp(-g) of it (rolled off towards white): add g * strength - (1 - exp(-g)) to the colour, so strength 1 gives the glow at full brightness, 0 none

motion_vectors.encoding: red and green: each pixel's shift to the next frame, across and down, in fractions of a frame's size: (value - 0.5) * 2 * strength. Draw a frame t of the way to the next by sampling this frame at uv - shift * t and the next at uv + shift * (1 - t), and blending
